## Fixes

- The public key is now always automatically populated whenever selecting a private SSH key
- Fix Windows auto-updater leaving a console window open when running in powershell
- Fix hetzner cloud integration being broken with latest version of the hcloud CLI
- The ForceHiDpiOptimizations RDP setting is now not always overriden if it is already specified
- Improve k8s refresh handling when no context was set in kubeconfig
